answer_1.quote: Our approach adopts a unified LLM architecture trained with an integrated generation loss, which preserves the model's ability to generate fluent and contextually appropriate responses.

answer_2.quote: We employ standard information retrieval metrics to evaluate retrieval effectiveness, including Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at rank 3 (nDCG@3), and Hit Rate at rank k (Hit@k).
